localChanges: chore: update core-city, library-city and civ1-city

log: `civ1-city:player/action/change-worked-tile` gives a player a `ChangeWorkedTile` action for each of their cities. It isn't mandatory, so `SimpleAIClient` never sees it. `lib/assignWorkers` re-exports `changeWorkedTile` from `library-city`, and new tests cover the action rule and each outcome (civ-clone/web-renderer#9).
Raises the floors to core-city ^0.1.15 and library-city ^0.1.3, the first releases with `PlayerActions/ChangeWorkedTile` and `changeWorkedTile`.

The offered-for-each-city test now founds two cities for one player in the same world. The another-city test registers a tile worked by another city inside this city's radius: before, the other city was in a separate world, so its tile was refused for being outside the radius instead. Assertions compare positions and ids, because a failing `eql` on a `Tile` or `City` deep-prints the whole world.
A `PlayerAction<City>` for changing which tiles a `City` works, so a client can offer it through `Player#actions()` and have it validated like any other action (civ-clone/web-renderer#9).

Toggles a single tile for a `City`: a tile the city works is released; any other tile is worked by a free worker if `CanBeWorked` allows it and the player has seen it; with every worker placed, the city's workers are reassigned via `reassignWorkers`. The city centre and tiles outside `City#tiles()` are left alone. Returns what it did (civ-clone/web-renderer#9).
